name: Interminable Rooms: EXPANDED
desc:
PLEASE LIKE THE GAME 👍

🌐 Make sure to join the group! You can see it in the game.
🐛 This game only is maintained by three people, expect bugs.
🌲 The Outdoors has released! Make sure to go check it out!
⚠️ This game contains extreme flashing lights.


🕹️ - Interminable Rooms
Interminable Rooms: EXPANDED is a game where you survive entities and have infinite lives (not for the original game), also this game is more preferrably played on public servers.

📗 - Changelogs
If you want to see the game's changelog, please join the game and press F9 to activate the developer console and see for yourself, there is way more information there than here

🎮 - Controls
- [H] -> Hides all GUIs
- [K] -> Allow mouse movement while in 1st person
- [T] -> Toggle Screenshake
- [G] -> Toggle Top-Screen Developer GUI
- [C] -> Toggle Zoom In
- [P] -> Open Badge List GUI
- [End] -> Take a Screenshot
- [L Ctrl] -> Crouch 

Thanks to MrCraftis756 and BLACKSTAR for maintaining this game for now!
